def factor_herding_volume_price_position_asymmetry(df):
    """Volume-weighted close position within trailing high-low range, minus neutral."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high_roll = df_copy["high"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).max()
    low_roll = df_copy["low"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).min()
    range_ = high_roll - low_roll
    position = (df_copy["close"] - low_roll) / range_.replace(0, np.nan)
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    vol_sum = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    weighted_pos = (volume * position).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / vol_sum.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = 2 * weighted_pos - 1
    return factor.rename("factor_herding_volume_price_position_asymmetry")
description: Measures directional consensus by computing the volume-weighted average position of close within the trailing 20-day high-low range. A high positive value indicates that recent volume is concentrated near the upper range as prices crowd upward; a low negative value indicates volume near the lower range. This continuous crowding metric is more stable than simple sign(close-open) volume imbalance and reflects herding pressure.
